title: How to Listen to Live College Football Games on SiriusXM
summary: Get access to dozens of game broadcasts each week on your radio and smart device.
body_markdown:
Throughout the 2026[college football](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/category/sports/college-football) season, SiriusXM listeners get access to dozens of game broadcasts each week involving teams from the SEC, Big Ten, Big 12, ACC, and other conferences, plus Notre Dame, Army, Navy, HBCU football, and more.


[College Football Live play-by-play, analysis & more Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogCollegeFootball-League)


## College Football on SiriusXM


### How to Listen to Live Games


You can get live coverage of college football games with home and away feeds for every team on your radio with SiriusXM and your smart device with the SiriusXM app.


#### Broadcast Schedule


[View the full SiriusXM broadcast schedule](https://www.siriusxm.com/sports/college-football) to find out which channels are carrying each game.


### Daily Talk, News, and Expert Analysis


SiriusXM offers fans the most in-depth radio coverage of college football with daily talk, up-to-the-moment news, and expert analysis on its college sports-focused channels:


[SiriusXM College Sports Radio](https://sxm.app.link/BlogCollegeFootball-SiriusXMCollegeSportsRadio) Channel 84 • College sports talk & live games


[SiriusXM ACC Radio](https://sxm.app.link/BlogCollegeFootball-SiriusXMACCRadio) Channel 371 • 24/7 ACC talk & live games


[SiriusXM Big Ten Radio](https://sxm.app.link/BlogCollegeFootball-SiriusXMBigTenRadio) Channel 372 • 24/7 Big Ten talk & live games


[SiriusXM SEC Radio](https://sxm.app.link/BlogCollegeFootball-SiriusXMSECRadio) Channel 374 • 24/7 SEC talk & live games


### SiriusXM College Sports Radio


Tune in to[SiriusXM College Sports Radio (Ch. 84)](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/college-sports-radio) daily to get all the latest news involving your favorite teams, plus discussions on the headline stories happening around college football from a roster of hosts that includes former players and coaches, Heisman Trophy winners, and National Champions.


SiriusXM College Sports Radio’s daily weekday schedule includes “Dusty and Danny in the Morning” with Dusty Dvoracek and Danny Kanell, “Full Ride” with Rick Neuheisel and Chris Childers, “College Sports Today” with Kris Budden, Nicole Auerbach, Roddy Jones, and Ben Hartsock, and “Off Campus” with Jacob Hester and E.J. Manuel.


[College Sports Radio Live game coverage, analysis & more Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogCollegeFootball-SiriusXMCollegeSportsRadio)


SiriusXM’s team of expert college football hosts and analysts also includes Jake Butt, Bobby Carpenter, Chris Doering, Anthony Herron, Damian Harris, Aaron Murray, Geoff Schwartz, Alyssa Lang, Gino Torretta, Fozzy Whittaker, Holly Rowe, and many others.
